summary.text: Paul Novotny is a Republican who represents District 30B in the Minnesota House of Representatives and was first elected in 2020.

His official House page lists committee assignments including Public Safety Finance and Policy, Ways and Means, Higher Education Finance and Policy, and Judiciary Finance and Civil Law, and gives his occupation as law enforcement, with an A.A.S. in law enforcement from North Hennepin Community College.

sources.title: Rep. Paul Novotny (30B) - Minnesota House of Representatives
